components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The scarce signal-red command for the primary action in a workflow.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.58 0.209 25); color: #fff; padding: .75rem 1rem; font: 800 .78rem/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 4px 4px 8px rgba(166,50,60,.42), -4px -4px 8px rgba(255,100,110,.42); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.05), box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.209 25); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 6px 6px 12px rgba(166,50,60,.55), inset -6px -6px 12px rgba(255,100,110,.38); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A raised chassis key for ordinary commands.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.52); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.928 0.014 248); color: oklch(0.302 0.026 255); padding: .75rem 1rem; font: 800 .78rem/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 5px 5px 10px oklch(0.79 0.02 248), -5px -5px 10px oklch(0.996 0.003 220); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.05), box-shadow 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); color: oklch(0.58 0.209 25); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.209 25); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 6px 6px 12px oklch(0.79 0.02 248), inset -6px -6px 12px oklch(0.996 0.003 220); }

components.name: Navigation Key
components.description: A physical view selector with label and technical caption.
components.css: .ds-nav-key { display: grid; gap: .14rem; min-width: 12rem; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.928 0.014 248); color: oklch(0.302 0.026 255); padding: .68rem .85rem; text-align: left; box-shadow: 3px 3px 8px rgba(186,190,204,.72), -3px -3px 8px rgba(255,255,255,.86); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.05), color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-key strong { font: 800 1rem/1.15 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-key small { color: oklch(0.392 0.022 252); font: 800 .7rem/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-nav-key:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); color: oklch(0.58 0.209 25); } .ds-nav-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.209 25); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-key:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 5px 5px 10px oklch(0.79 0.02 248), inset -5px -5px 10px oklch(0.996 0.003 220); }

components.name: Data Input
components.description: A recessed numeric or technical-value well.
components.css: .ds-data-field { display: grid; gap: .35rem; border-radius: 18px; background: oklch(0.928 0.014 248); padding: .62rem .72rem; color: oklch(0.392 0.022 252); font: 800 .7rem/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px oklch(0.79 0.02 248), inset -4px -4px 8px oklch(0.996 0.003 220); } .ds-data-field input { min-height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.302 0.026 255); font: 800 1.15rem/1.15 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; outline: none; } .ds-data-field:focus-within { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.209 25); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Raised Panel
components.description: A mounted functional module with restrained corner fasteners.
components.html:
Thermal Runtime

Live state and controls remain in one mounted module.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; max-width: 24rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.54); border-radius: 22px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 10% 8%, rgba(255,255,255,.86), transparent 24%), oklch(0.928 0.014 248); padding: 1rem; color: oklch(0.302 0.026 255); box-shadow: 8px 8px 16px oklch(0.79 0.02 248), -8px -8px 16px oklch(0.996 0.003 220); } .ds-panel::before { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; content: ''; background: radial-gradient(circle at 14px 14px, rgba(45,52,54,.18) 2px, transparent 3px), radial-gradient(circle at calc(100% - 14px) 14px, rgba(45,52,54,.18) 2px, transparent 3px), radial-gradient(circle at 14px calc(100% - 14px), rgba(45,52,54,.18) 2px, transparent 3px), radial-gradient(circle at calc(100% - 14px) calc(100% - 14px), rgba(45,52,54,.18) 2px, transparent 3px); } .ds-panel-title { position: relative; font: 800 1.35rem/1.1 Manrope, sans-serif; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fff; } .ds-panel p { position: relative; margin: .7rem 0 0; color: oklch(0.392 0.022 252); font: 600 1rem/1.45 Manrope, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A recessed text-and-light device state indicator.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .42rem; border: 1px solid rgba(163,177,198,.72); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(240,242,245,.74); padding: .45rem .65rem; color: oklch(0.392 0.022 252); font: 800 .7rem/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 4px rgba(186,190,204,.62), inset -2px -2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,.78); } .ds-status i { width: .6rem; height: .6rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.72 0.154 151); box-shadow: 0 0 10px 2px rgba(34,197,94,.7); } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.209 25); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Flux Purr Web Console behaves like a compact bench instrument: every surface has physical position, every state has operational meaning, and the operator can scan a dense workspace without mistaking decoration for capability. Its industrial skeuomorphism comes from material logic rather than nostalgia. The system is tactile but disciplined. Raised controls invite manipulation, recessed fields and displays receive information, and dark technical surfaces isolate logs or device readouts. Screws, scanlines, texture, and LED glow are signature details only when they reinforce mounting, material, or status.
keyCharacteristics: Light-mode cool-grey chassis with restrained signal color.
Top-left illumination and structurally paired highlights and shadows.
Recognizable controls with explicit hover, focus, pressed, selected, and disabled states.
Dense single-device workbench layouts that preserve transport and safety context.
Technical data in mono; interface language in a compact humanist sans.

rules.name: The Signal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Signal red owns interaction emphasis; green and yellow communicate device state and never become ordinary decorative accents.

rules.name: The Live-State Rule
rules.body: Live, mock, offline, degraded, and unsupported states must differ through words or shape as well as color.

rules.name: The Data Face Rule
rules.body: Measurements, identifiers, timestamps, and machine state use the mono face; prose and navigation stay in the humanist face.

rules.name: The One Bench Rule
rules.body: Keep one active device and its immediate workflow in view; do not turn the console into a fleet dashboard or a field of unrelated cards.

rules.name: The Fixed-Light Rule
rules.body: Highlights always come from the top-left; mixed lighting breaks the instrument illusion.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevation must explain whether an element is mounted, manipulable, recessed, or emitting light. It is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Mounted-Part Rule
rules.body: A curve, border, groove, or fastener must clarify the physical role of the element it belongs to.

dos: Do preserve the top-left lighting model across every raised and recessed surface.
Do keep standard buttons, inputs, switches, segmented controls, and destructive actions recognizable.
Do show transport, lease, capability, and safety boundaries at the point of action.
Do use mechanical detail selectively to explain mounting, state, or interaction.
Do preserve responsive target sizes and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't present mock or stale telemetry as live hardware state.
Don't turn the Web App into a marketing landing page, fleet dashboard, or generic SaaS settings shell.
Don't use signal red as broad decoration or use status green/yellow for ordinary interaction.
Don't nest decorative cards or give every region equal elevation.
Don't introduce glass surfaces, arbitrary gradients, inconsistent lighting, or ornamental mechanical clutter.
